title: Data Retention Schedule by Type
description: Four kinds of club data, four different clocks -- and what event starts each one.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

educational.audience: Club leaders writing a retention policy

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a type of club data, the learner classifies how long it is retained and what event starts the deletion clock.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any band for how long that data is kept and what starts the countdown
pedagogical.assessment: Given a record, say when it gets deleted and what triggers it.
